blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover several core cases but omit important documented behavior such as measurements/control-table recovery, CRC and field validation, truncated records, Tukey filtering, negative-control fallback, multi-run calibration, and explicit serialization/order requirements.

deterministic_tests: The verifier performs apt-get and downloads uv and packages from astral.sh, so test execution depends on mutable external network resources and can fail independently of the submitted work.

valid_failure_modes: The test harness has an invalid environmental failure mode because it requires apt repositories and a live external download for uv and packages, despite the task itself being local and deterministic.
advice: test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile installs pytest in the runtime image even though pytest is only needed by the verifier; test.sh separately installs its own pytest environment.
